To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a synthesis of an implementation for the communication through random addressed bus interfaces can be achieved by applying annotated data type descriptions and that this synthesis is more efficient than a synthesis that does not take the information content of the tokens into account.
the synthesis of the internal communication structure of an addressed token passing network is facilitated through the use of annotated data type descriptions.

(1) the communication structure of the component is synthesized as a token passing network; (2) the information carried by a token is split into address and data parts; (3) state changes are distinguished from workload data and handled separately; (4) the token passing network is synthesized as a state distribution network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of communication structures in hardware components that are based on random addressable bus networks.

the development of a methodology for the synthesis of a hardware implementation of the communication structure from the description of the functionality of a component in terms of a set of communicating processes.
the development of a new methodology for the synthesis of pipelined architectures from behavioral descriptions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper is an interesting approach to a new design method.
the approach is a good candidate for the design of high-performance, high-speed, and low power consumption digital circuits.
the approach of using annotated data type descriptions is a promising method for the design of hardware components with random addressable bus communication interfaces.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesis of a communication structure is achieved by a decomposition of the functionality into smaller components and by a partitioning of the data into state changes and payload data.
a hardware component is described by its interface, which is specified by its input and output data type and by the communication protocol that is used.
we can describe a hardware design by annotated data types, which are used as input for the design of a random addressable token passing communication network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
annotated data types can be used to synthesize communication structures for the implementation of a component.
the annotated data type descriptions are a powerful means to synthesize the hardware communication structure of a component's implementation.
the synthesis of an addressed token passing network can be achieved through the application of a set of simple and efficient rules.
